WITH b AS (
  SELECT cls, fished_date_season AS season, fished_date_doy AS doy,
         CAST(fished_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS bucket, yt, anglers
  FROM trips
  WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','full_day','hd_twilight')
)
SELECT cls, bucket, COUNT(*) AS n_boatdays, SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS rate
FROM b
GROUP BY cls, bucket
HAVING SUM(anglers) > 50
ORDER BY bucket, cls;
SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 3;
